title: character sprite sheet for games
author: avanlabs
selftext:
I was trying to find an easy way to generate sprite sheets of characters I want to use in games. I tried different methods, LLMs. Tried lengthy prompts but never got clean working sprite sheet. Just stumbled upon ludo ai. It gave me amazing output with single image and basic prompt. paid. This is not a promotion.

I used this spritesheet to get a prompt from chatgpt. It gave me really bad output. achieving good result with just vibe coding tool does not seem easy.

Any simple and economical way to achieve this?

https://reddit.com/link/1qxqsqp/video/maz1tvykaxhg1/player

comments.author: mike402
comments.body: Ludo.ai has a product built for generating usable assets for games. That’s why it works so well. Of course ChatGPT won’t be able to do this for you…
